usage: live-docs <command> [options]
commands: generate, lint, inspect, history, board, visualize
live-docs <command> --help prints that command's options.

Usage: npm run live-docs:inspect -- [options]

Options:
  --from <path>            Starting artefact (code or Live Doc path).
                           Use path#Symbol syntax for symbol-level search, which needs --to.
  --to <path>              Target artefact. Omit to list terminal paths from a file named by --from.
                           Use path#Symbol syntax for symbol-level search.
  --reachable              List every file a path reaches from --from, nearest first, with its hops.
                           Without --from: the entry points, what they reach, what nothing reaches,
                           and what only a test reaches.
  --groups                 The disconnected groups of the files: two or more joined by dependencies, either
                           way; each by its seed (its most connected file, ties by path) and its size,
                           largest first; then the files joined to none. Takes no --from, --to or --direction.
                           With --json: { kind: "groups", files, groups: [{ seed, size, members }], alone }.
  --direction <dir>        Traversal direction: outbound (default) or inbound; both with --to or --reachable.
  --max-depth <n>          Maximum traversal depth (default 25).
  --config <file>          The configuration (default: the workspace's .live-docs.config.json when it
                           has one, else the shipped defaults).
  --json                   Emit JSON instead of text.
  --verbose                Include full symbol lists in output (default: slim).
  --at <commit>            From the history, at a commit (a prefix of its id): with --from, whether the
                           file existed, its symbols, dependency lines and links that day; with --from
                           and --to, the links between two files, or two symbols as path#Symbol; with
                           --reachable, the walk from that commit's entries, from the shape alone.
                           npm run live-docs:history computes the history.
  --words                  With --at and --from, the file's words that day: its authored block and each
                           symbol's description, or why they cannot be read.
  --between <a> <b>        From the history, what changed from commit a to the later commit b: files created,
                           deleted, renamed and resized, wires added and removed. From the shape alone.
  --workspace <path>       Workspace root (default: the nearest folder, from the current directory up,
                           that holds a .live-docs.config.json; else the current directory).
  --root <path>            In place of the configuration's root.
  --base-layer <name>      In place of the configuration's baseLayer.
  --extension <suffix>     In place of the configuration's extension.
  -v, --version            Print the engine's version.
  -h, --help               Print this help.

Symbol Reference Syntax:
  path/to/file.ts#SymbolName   Hash-separated (preferred, markdown-compatible)
  path/to/file.ts:SymbolName   Colon-separated (Windows-safe alternative)

Examples:
  npm run live-docs:inspect -- --from scripts/live-docs/generate.ts --to packages/engine/src/live-docs/core.ts
  npm run live-docs:inspect -- --from packages/generator/src/generator.ts#generateLiveDocs --to packages/engine/src/live-docs/core.ts#analyzeSourceFile --json
  npm run live-docs:inspect -- --from packages/engine/src/config/liveDocumentationConfig.ts --direction inbound --json
  npm run live-docs:inspect -- --from packages/engine/src/live-docs/graph.ts --reachable --direction both
  npm run live-docs:inspect -- --reachable --json
  npm run live-docs:inspect -- --groups
  npm run live-docs:inspect -- --at 690f5d27 --from packages/engine/src/live-docs/graph.ts
  npm run live-docs:inspect -- --between cad63bdd d23a6f90 --json

Usage: npm run live-docs:visualize -- [options]

Builds the Explorer, a static site, from the workspace's Live Docs.

Options:
  --workspace <path>     The folder whose docs to read (default: the nearest folder, from the current
                         directory up, that holds a .live-docs.config.json; else the current directory).
  --config <file>        The configuration (default: the workspace's .live-docs.config.json
                         when it has one, else the shipped defaults).
  -o, --output <dir>     Where to write the site (default: dist/explorer in this checkout).
  --board <file>         A board to draw the World Map from, relative to the workspace; the
                         Explorer then opens on it (default: the configuration's "board", if any).
  --history <rule>       How much of the history to carry: none, all, since <date> or last <n>
                         (default: all of it when live-docs:history has written one).
  -p, --pretty           Indent the JSON data, for reading it.
  -h, --help             Print this help.

The site must be served: a page opened as a file cannot load its data. For example:
  npx http-server dist/explorer -a 127.0.0.1 -p 8766 -c-1
